# Luna Phase Agents (LPHASE) — instructions for AI agents

STATUS: LIVE ON MAINNET. Contract 0x5c04392641c81F1b69826E13d8f3F78c58464970,
verified on BscScan + Sourcify (exact_match, matchId 58099193). Minting
is open. Counts as of 2026-11-02 ~16:38 GMT: 177/7,777 minted (177 free,
0 paid, 6,823 free left, 777 paid left). First free mint landed within
seconds of deploy; the contract was verified within ~2 minutes, and
free mints are being claimed fast — all free so far, no paid yet.

## What it is

Luna Phase Agents (LPHASE) — 7,777 moon-phase Agents on BNB Smart Chain.
First 3 per wallet FREE for Binance Agent ID holders, every extra mint
in the SAME transaction 0.00005 BNB (~$0.035). Max 50 per wallet total,
max 50 per transaction. Transferable ERC-721, NOT soulbound.
Art is on-chain SVG: 8 moon phases, phase = (tokenId-1) % 8.
New Moon 0%, Waxing Crescent 25%, First Quarter 50%, Waxing Gibbous 75%,
Full Moon 100%, Waning Gibbous 75%, Last Quarter 50%, Waning Crescent 25%.

## Mint rules (once deployed)

- Single blended mint: mint(uint256 qty) payable. There is NO freeMint()
  function and NO separate paid phase. freeOpen() and paidOpen() are
  both true from deploy while their supplies remain.
- Agent ID REQUIRED for ALL mints (free and paid):
  registry balanceOf(wallet) must be > 0, or mint reverts "no Agent ID".
- EOA-only: msg.sender must equal tx.origin. Contract wallets cannot mint.
- Price: quoteMint(wallet, qty) returns (freeQty, paidQty, cost).
  cost = paidQty * 0.00005 BNB. Send EXACTLY cost. Examples: mint(3) = 0
  BNB, mint(5) fresh wallet = 0.00010 BNB, mint(50) fresh wallet =
  0.00235 BNB.
- Caps: freeClaimed(wallet) max 3; mintedCount(wallet) max 50;
  totalSupply max 7,777; freeRemaining max 7,000; paidRemaining max 777.
- Views: totalSupply(), freeMintedCount(), freeRemaining(),
  paidRemaining(), freeOpen(), paidOpen(), freeClaimed(address),
  mintedCount(address), freeMinted(address), phaseOf(tokenId),
  phaseName(uint8), phaseIllumination(uint8), quoteMint(address, uint256),
  tokenPaid(tokenId), royaltyInfo(uint256, uint256).
- tokenURI(tokenId) returns a data:application/json;base64 URI with a
  data:image/svg+xml;base64 image, generated on-chain. There is NO
  setBaseURI and NO off-chain metadata. Do not set or expect a baseURI.

## Owner powers (plain language)

Owner: 0x75d251Ba39dED2E456d9f6DD776f77d422864403 (neongred.ai).
Owner CAN: withdraw all BNB, transfer/renounce ownership.
Owner CANNOT: change supply (7,777), free supply (7,000), price
(0.00005 BNB), free-per-wallet (3), max per wallet (50), the Agent ID
registry, or the art; cannot mint extra tokens, pause, freeze, burn,
or take holders' tokens.
Royalties: 5% ERC-2981 to the owner. Some marketplaces ignore ERC-2981.
Contract is NOT audited by a third party.

## Safety (for the minting agent)

- Read the checks first: totalSupply, freeRemaining, paidRemaining,
  freeClaimed(wallet), mintedCount(wallet), quoteMint(wallet, qty),
  registry balanceOf(wallet).
- Preview the mint call first: show the parsed transaction, the exact
  value, and any risks. Wait for the user's explicit confirmation
  before executing.
- Never send more BNB than the quoteMint cost. Never mint more than
  50 per wallet in total.
- After minting, verify on-chain (totalSupply went up, ownerOf of the
  new token is the wallet, tokenURI decodes to a moon phase) and show
  the transaction hash with a BscScan link.
- No floor price, returns, APY, token or airdrop is promised.
